# Udofin `env/` — how to use (v1.3, 26 October 2026)

This folder implements IPB-11 (Environment and Seed Standard) for Udofin. It is copied into the repository root as `env/` in Phase 0 and is the only place environment variables are documented.

## Files

| File | Committed? | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `.env.example` | Yes | Annotated template of every variable Udofin reads (165 variables). Placeholders and local defaults only. Regenerated by `pnpm env:example` from `packages/config/env.schema.ts`; never edited by hand. |
| `SEED_CREDENTIALS.md` | **No** (gitignored, ruleset-blocked) | The lead-issued seed personas for non-production. Lives on the developer's machine and in the seed vault only. The copy in the master-prompt folder is for the owner's records. |
| `README.md` | Yes | This guide. |

## How to use

1. **Local:** `cp env/.env.example .env.local`, fill the `req:all` and `req:nonprod` values (local defaults work with `docker compose up` for PostgreSQL, Redis, Temporal, Keycloak, Cerbos, GoRules, MinIO, ClamAV, Gotenberg, MailHog and the OTel collector). Then `pnpm env:check` (Zod schema validation), `pnpm db:migrate`, `pnpm seed --profile dev`, `pnpm seed:credentials`.
2. **Dev, test, demo, staging:** values come from the environment or the secret store, never from a file in the repository. Every `sens:S` variable is a `secret://` reference resolved by the `SECRETS` port at boot; a literal secret in these environments fails boot with `IPB-ENV-003`.
3. **Production and DR:** additionally `NODE_ENV=production`, `DB_SSL_MODE=verify-full`, `SEED_ENABLED` unset, `SEED_PROFILE` unset, `AUTH_BREAK_GLASS_ENABLED=false`, `AI_OBS_CAPTURE_CONTENT=false`, `PAYMENTS_HOSTED_CHECKOUT_ONLY=true`, `UDF_NO_MONEY_FLOW_GUARD=true`, `IPB_DATA_RESIDENCY=IN`, `APP_REGION` in {ap-south-1, ap-south-2}. Boot refuses any other value (IPB-11 §11.3.C). Test-mode payment keys (`rzp_test_`) are refused.
4. **Client bundles:** only `EXPO_PUBLIC_*` and `NEXT_PUBLIC_*` reach the app or browser, and they hold public configuration only. Anything in an OTA bundle is public. Build-time secrets use EAS secret-visibility variables and are never read into `app.config` `extra`.
5. **White-label builds (Phase 23):** `EXPO_PUBLIC_BRAND_PACK_ID` and the pack's bundle identifiers are injected per EAS channel at build time from the brand-pack record; they are never committed.

## Rules that never change

- **Never commit real values.** `.env`, `.env.*` (except `.env.example`), `SEED_CREDENTIALS.md`, keystores, provisioning profiles and certificates are gitignored and blocked by the ruleset; `secrets-scan` runs on every PR.
- **Seeds never run in production.** `pnpm seed*` refuses when `APP_ENV` is `prod` or `dr`; seed persona emails (`*@udofin.test`) are on the production invitation deny-list.
- **Super admin everywhere is `rjnprajapati@gmail.com`** (IPB-D-04). In production the account is created by invitation link; the first login forces a password change and MFA.
- **No real borrower, KYC, bureau or loan data** in any environment outside India-region hosting (CF para 14(4)); non-production uses synthetic data from the seed profiles only.
- **Udofin never moves money.** `UDF_NO_MONEY_FLOW_GUARD` cannot be set to false; the RE's gateway, mandate and disbursement credentials live in the per-RE vault, never in this file.

## Variable groups

`APP_`, `DB_` (+ `UDF_WELLNESS_DB_`), `CACHE_`/`QUEUE_`, `WORKFLOW_`, `AUTH_`, `AUTHZ_`/`RULES_`, `STORAGE_`, `SEARCH_`, `DOCGEN_`, `SECRETS_`, `AI_` (incl. `AI_VIDHI_*`), `PAYMENTS_`, `MSG_`, `VOICE_`, `OBS_`, `FLAGS_`, `IPB_`, `UDF_`, `UDF_MKT_`/`UDF_CMS_`, `SEED_`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_`, `EXPO_PUBLIC_`. Each variable's comment states its description, the environments where it is required (`req:`) and its sensitivity (`sens:` S secret, C configuration, P public).

## Seed profiles

| Profile | Purpose | Contents |
|---|---|---|
| `dev` | Day-to-day development | Personas above, two demo REs, catalogue, one borrower journey at each state, "i" registry seed, default brand pack |
| `demo` | Owner and RE demonstrations | `dev` plus the IPB-11 §11.4.8 narrative (offers from two REs, cooling-off active, one grievance open), 12-locale strings, Vidhi notebooks |
| `test` | CI | Minimal deterministic fixtures; credentials only in the job's ephemeral vault (`--no-file`) |
| `load` | Performance | 1 million synthetic borrowers, 100 REs; requires `SEED_LOAD_CONFIRM=yes` and a non-shared database |

## Where the rules live

IPB-11 (`docs/ipb/IPB-11_Environment_and_Seed_Standard.md`), Udofin Master Prompt v1.3 Part 11.3 and Part 10.1A, IPB-D-04. Questions on a variable: read its comment, then `packages/config/env.schema.ts`.
